12 Open-Source GitHub Repositories to Learn AI and LLM Engineering From Scratch

This article gives you a practical path through 12 open-source GitHub repositories, starting with mathematics and AI fundamentals and progressing toward language models, training, and deep learning research.

1. Mathematics for Machine Learning
Repository: mml-book/mml-book.github.io (https://github.com/mml-book/mml-book.github.io?utm_campaign=x&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=read.vijayasekhardeepak.com)
Difficulty: Beginner to Intermediate
What it is: A companion repository for the book Mathematics for Machine Learning.

2. Microsoft AI For Beginners
Repository: microsoft/AI-For-Beginners (https://github.com/microsoft/AI-For-Beginners?utm_campaign=x&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=read.vijayasekhardeepak.com)
Difficulty: Beginner
What it is: A beginner-friendly AI curriculum containing 24 lessons, practical labs, and quizzes.

3. Microsoft Generative AI for Beginners
Repository: microsoft/generative-ai-for-beginners (https://github.com/microsoft/generative-ai-for-beginners?utm_campaign=x&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=read.vijayasekhardeepak.com)
Difficulty: Beginner
What it is: A 21-lesson curriculum that combines explanations of generative AI concepts with practical application-building exercises.

4. Prompt Engineering Guide
Repository: dair-ai/Prompt-Engineering-Guide (https://github.com/dair-ai/Prompt-Engineering-Guide?utm_campaign=x&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=read.vijayasekhardeepak.com)
Difficulty: Beginner to Intermediate
What it is: A collection of guides, papers, lessons, notebooks, and resources covering prompt engineering and related topics.

5. LLM Course by Maarten Grootendorst
Repository: mlabonne/llm-course (https://github.com/mlabonne/llm-course?utm_campaign=x&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=read.vijayasekhardeepak.com)
Difficulty: Intermediate
What it is: A free course for learning large language models through learning roadmaps, notebooks, and practical resources. The course is organized around LLM Fundamentals, The LLM Scientist, and The LLM Engineer.

6. Build LLMs From Scratch
Repository: rasbt/LLMs-from-scratch (https://github.com/rasbt/LLMs-from-scratch?utm_campaign=x&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=read.vijayasekhardeepak.com)
Difficulty: Intermediate to Advanced
What it is: The official code repository for Sebastian Raschka's book Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch).

7. Train LLM From Scratch
Repository: FareedKhan-dev/train-llm-from-scratch (https://github.com/FareedKhan-dev/train-llm-from-scratch?utm_campaign=x&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=read.vijayasekhardeepak.com)
Difficulty: Intermediate to Advanced
What it is: A PyTorch implementation of a language-model training pipeline.

8. NanoChat
Repository: karpathy/nanochat (https://github.com/karpathy/nanochat?utm_campaign=x&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=read.vijayasekhardeepak.com)
Difficulty: Advanced
What it is: Andrej Karpathy's compact experimental system for training and working with LLMs.

9. Hugging Face ML Intern
Repository: huggingface/ml-intern (https://github.com/huggingface/ml-intern?utm_campaign=x&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=read.vijayasekhardeepak.com)
Difficulty: Advanced
What it is: An open-source ML engineering agent designed to research topics and work with code across the Hugging Face ecosystem.
Important status note: The repository is archived, and its hosted application and CLI have been retired. Treat it as a historical case study, not a maintained tool to depend on for current workflows.

10. Harvard CS249r: Machine Learning Systems
Repository: harvard-edge/cs249r_book (https://github.com/harvard-edge/cs249r_book?utm_campaign=x&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=read.vijayasekhardeepak.com)
Difficulty: Intermediate to Advanced
What it is: A textbook and learning resource focused on the engineering principles behind machine learning systems.

11. Annotated Deep Learning Paper Implementations
Repository: labmlai/annotated_deep_learning_paper_implementations (https://github.com/labmlai/annotated_deep_learning_paper_implementations?utm_campaign=x&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=read.vijayasekhardeepak.com)
Difficulty: Advanced
What it is: A collection of documented PyTorch implementations of deep learning papers.

12. AI Engineering From Scratch
Repository: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch (https://github.com/rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch?utm_campaign=x&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=read.vijayasekhardeepak.com)
Difficulty: Beginner to Advanced, depending on the learning path
What it is: A broad, structured curriculum spanning mathematics, machine learning, deep learning, language models, AI engineering, agents, and production topics.
